verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server and multiple framework guides (Claude, n8n, Dify, Open WebUI, OpenClaw) that expose ready-made tool schemas for agent consumption, and markets an 'LLM Context' endpoint built for machine consumption. However, no public OpenAPI/function-calling schema was found (404s on openapi.json/docs.md), and community evidence shows the standard API's ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate paid AI plan—creating real friction for the exact 'plug into an agent' use case being advertised.
